name: Beijing Onmicro Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Onmicro Electronics Co., Ltd., an integrated circuit design company, engages in research, development, design, and sale of RF front-end chips, RF SoC chips, and other analog chips. Its products are used in 5G/4G/2G smartphones, automotive electronics, smart home and mesh, smart wearing, electric vehicle instruments, smart pens, bluetooth voice remote control, wireless keyboard and mouse, fingerprint locks, smart body fat scale/ figure clip oximeter, findmy, antenna running, and Internet of Things applications. Beijing Onmicro Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
